jobDescription: A payments acquirer is rebuilding how small merchants apply for card acceptance, moving from paper forms to an online application with automated identity checks. The Project Manager plans and tracks delivery with the product owner and two engineering squads, takes each release through the firm's change-approval board, runs pilot workshops with end customers and front-line staff, and reports progress to the head of merchant services. The hiring panel receives a factual summary of each applicant's evidence and makes all selection decisions itself. The project sits in the merchant services division and runs alongside a regulatory change to customer due-diligence rules. The product owner sets priorities, while the project manager keeps the plan, the risk log and the release calendar.
requirements: Plans and tracks delivery across two engineering squads with the product owner.
Takes changes through the change-approval board with complete impact and back-out plans.
Designs anti-money-laundering onboarding controls into customer journeys.
Runs pilot workshops with end customers and front-line staff.
Reports delivery progress, risks and spend to a senior sponsor every month.

evidence.text: Planned and tracked delivery for the account-opening rebuild at Tamberline Credit Union, running fortnightly planning with the product owner and two engineering squads against a single release plan.

Took 23 releases through the change-approval board, each submitted with an impact assessment, test evidence and a back-out plan; the board deferred two of them, which were re-submitted the following week.
Ran six pilot workshops with members and branch staff to test the new online application before launch, recording every change request raised in the sessions.
Sent a monthly progress report to the chief operating officer covering milestones, the risk log and spend against the approved budget.
Worked with the financial-crime team on the identity-verification step of the application, documenting which checks the vendor's service runs.
Work sample: the pilot workshop log, listing the six sessions with dates and attendee groups, the 31 change requests raised and the product owner's decision on each one.
HR verification note: employment at Tamberline Credit Union from March 2021 to the present as Project Manager, Digital Change, checked against the employer's confirmation letter.
Recruiter logistics note: the candidate can attend the panel interview on the 14th or the 16th and would need to give one month's notice.
